A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.

Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

definitions.extraction_instruction: Identify the issuer and announced event, distinguishing confirmed events from forecasts and preserving the supporting passage. Leave quantities unknown when absent.

definitions.extraction_instruction: Extract only confirmed HPAI-related layer culls, their region and reported count. Distinguish layers from other birds, unknown quantities from zero, and retain the supporting passage.

Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.

Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

inputs.description: Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Five-session momentum of the explicitly bound stock closing-price series.

Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

definitions.extraction_instruction: Identify the issuer and announced event, distinguishing confirmed events from forecasts and preserving the supporting passage. Leave quantities unknown when absent.

definitions.description: Five-session momentum of the USDA AMS national FOB caged white-large shell-egg index. The report date is visible on the next target session.
Proposed extraction of confirmed layer culls relevant to egg supply; not a pre-outbreak disease predictor.
definitions.extraction_instruction: Extract only confirmed HPAI-related layer culls, their region and reported count. Distinguish layers from other birds, unknown quantities from zero, and retain the supporting passage.

Five-session momentum of the CBOT corn future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the CBOT soybean-meal future. The session uses that day's close, carried at most six calendar days.
Five-session momentum of an equal-weight corn and soybean-meal index. Each leg is rebased to 100 on the first overlapping day.
Five-session momentum of the Henry Hub natural-gas future.
Five-session momentum of the dollar-peso rate.
Five-session momentum of weekly U.S. on-highway diesel. The price date is hidden that day and carried at most ten calendar days.
Five-session momentum of the effective federal funds rate. The effective date is hidden that day.
Twenty-session momentum of the share of the contiguous United States in moderate drought or worse. This is not a corn-belt index.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Easter, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.
Twenty-session momentum of the days until the next Thanksgiving, plus one so the holiday itself stays positive.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

output.execution_note: Only numeric price recipes can enter this model. News guides hypothesis selection; no historical news features or event_signal columns are constructed. Financial ratios are computed from filing-dated retained facts; missing rows are not filled or dropped. Related-price recipes marked runnable share the fixed training/evaluation rows. Current company suggestions inform retrospective selection, not causal evidence. Bound factors retain exact source and ownership metadata; composites use explicit binding leaves. Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.

Pending sources cannot be replaced with target share prices.

input_usage.reason: Retrospective reconstruction from currently retained SEC facts, not a complete historical vendor archive. A filing date without an acceptance time becomes usable at 05:00 UTC on the following day. Only directly reported 70–110 day quarters in USD are used; no annual income values are silently converted. Cash-flow facts retain their reported 3/6/9/12-month durations and compare only matching year-over-year periods. Revisions are selected as of each cutoff. Inventory uses reported balance-sheet instants and comparable prior-year dates, not cash-flow inventory changes or the previous fiscal year-end by default.
